headline: ONEOK Inc's Dividend Analysis
summary: This article first appeared on GuruFocus.  ONEOK Inc (NYSE:OKE) recently announced a total dividend of $1.07 per share, with the ex-dividend date set for 2026-08-03.  This includes a $1.07 per share cash dividend payable on 2026-08-14.
